quests.instruction: IDENTIFY THE TARGET CONSONANT PHONEME IN THE WORD
quests.hint: At this level, listen for subtle articulation: is it closer to a voiceless dental fricative or a voiceless alveolar fricative in "thermal"?
quests.explanation: In "thermal", the target sound is /θ/, made by resting the tongue tip lightly between the teeth with no voice. The distractor /s/ would instead require hissing a thin stream of air over the tongue tip with no voice — a clearly different sound once you isolate it.
